scenes.say: Four pillars keep that knowledge in the building.
scenes.html:
Keep it in the building
4 pillars
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: One. Write the fix down where the next person will look, at the machine, by the asset, with photos.
scenes.html:
Pillar 1
1
Write the fix down at the machine, by the asset, with photos.
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Keep it short: the symptom, the cause, the fix, and a photo of the part. A two-line note at the machine beats a perfect manual nobody opens.
scenes.html:
Keep it short
Symptom.
Cause.
Fix.
Photo.
A two-line note at the machine beats a perfect manual nobody opens.

scenes.say: Two. Pair people up. Shadowing an experienced tech teaches what no binder can.

Pillar 2
2
Pair people up. Shadowing teaches what a binder can't.
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Send a newer technician on the next call with your most experienced one, and let the newer tech hold the meter.

hold the meter.
